cover_letter_text:
Hi,

I'm Marc. I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, and I'd like to begin as an entry-level CMT technician. The hands-on training with experienced technicians at your new Virginia lab is what I'm looking for.

In the diploma I worked with AS 1289 and AS 1726. Before that, on sites in the Philippines, I did inspections and quality checks and kept material and progress records, working with engineers and subcontractors.

I'd move to Brisbane and can start three weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa) and a full Victorian driver's licence. Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
